meta.description: Overdue loans of each borrower with what they repaid so far.
meta.sql:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE demo_ads.ads_collection_overdue_loan_df PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT b.customer_id,
       l.loan_no,
       l.principal_amt,
       COALESCE(r.repaid_amt, 0) AS repaid_amt
FROM demo_dwd.dwd_lending_borrower_df b
JOIN demo_dwd.dwd_lending_loan_df l ON b.customer_id = l.customer_id AND l.dt = '${bizdate}'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT loan_no, SUM(repay_amt) AS repaid_amt
    FROM demo_dwd.dwd_lending_repayment_di
    GROUP BY loan_no
) r ON l.loan_no = r.loan_no
WHERE b.dt = '${bizdate}' AND l.loan_status = '2'
